title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter on the price basis.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price.

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.

PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We attach two packages with a two-year term. The longer commitment gives you secure volume and less planning workload. Which of them suits you best, and are there cheaper variants you could offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We have verified the recent decreases in AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 and have adjusted our pricing accordingly. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

To support a 24-month contract, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material price volatility over the extended term. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Building on your preferred 30-day payment term, we can offer a revised price of €5.30 per unit with the index clause applied.

Our present proposal is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit, alongside a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - revised package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking our data into account.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

The attached package keeps the 24-month term and 60-day payment. A fixed price without an adjustment clause gives both sides a stable basis and spares you the administrative work of monthly surcharge calculations. Your owner offered to walk us through your calculation. Are there cheaper variants, for example in packaging or delivery batching, that you could offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

For a 24-month term, we must include the AS-14404 index clause, allowing us to offer a revised price of €5.20 per unit with 60-day payment. To summarize our offer, we can propose a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our colleagues will address your questions regarding the calculation walkthrough and delivery batching separately.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Part:370010 – revised package, 24-month term
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the cost-saving options you listed.

We have moved a clear step towards you in the attached package. It keeps the structure we proposed: 23,700 kg per year over 24 months, 60-day payment and a fixed price. A fixed price gives you planning certainty and removes the monthly surcharge calculations and their administrative work on both sides.

We are also open to discussing a doubled lot size if it lowers your cost further. What is the earliest date you could confirm it?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 – revised package, 24-month term
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We appreciate your increased offer and can reduce our price to €5.10 per unit. We cannot accept a fixed price for a 24-month term and must reinstate the AS-14404 index clause. Please provide the figures to support your claim regarding the administrative costs of the monthly surcharge calculations.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We are pleased to present our terms: a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, we can offer a package featuring a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.
